prompt.text:
Implement a complete TypeScript source file exporting `Permit`, `Route`, `RouteResolutionError`, and `resolveRoute`.

A permit contains `ownerId` and readonly `zones`. A route contains `id`, `zone`, integer `priority`, and `enabled`. Normalize all IDs and zones by trimming. Blank permit owners, permit zones, route IDs, or route zones throw `RangeError`; priorities must be finite integers. Duplicate normalized route IDs throw `Error("Duplicate route ID")`.

`resolveRoute(permit, routes)` considers only enabled routes whose zone exactly matches one of the permit's normalized zones. Return a defensive copy of the matching route with the lowest numeric priority; ties are resolved by earlier input order. If no route matches, throw `RouteResolutionError` with message `No route for <ownerId>` and readonly normalized `ownerId`.

An empty permit zone list or route list is valid and therefore produces the no-route error. Do not mutate or alias either input, and do not perform case folding.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
